title: Linear A: Where and What
short: The Minoan script, used about 1800 to 1450 BC: about 1,400 short inscriptions, most from Hagia Triada, Zakros, Chania and Phaistos.
trouble: Students think Linear A is a large body of texts. It is small: about 7,400 signs in all, mostly short lists, many damaged.

blocks.html: Now we turn to the older script, the one the Minoans of The Minoans of Crete used and the Mycenaeans borrowed (A Family of Aegean Scripts). Linear A has been known since Evans's time, and it is still unread. Before asking why, look at what there is to read.

Linear A is the Minoan script, used from about 1800 to 1450 BC. About 1,400 inscriptions survive, with about 7,400 signs in all, most of them short lists from Hagia Triada, Zakros, Chania and Phaistos.

items: Clay tablets: lists of words and numbers, like Linear B accounts.
Roundels, nodules and sealings: small clay pieces with seal impressions and a sign or two, used in administration.
Stone libation tables and vessels: offering objects from sanctuaries, carved with short religious texts (The Libation Formula).
Other objects: inscribed pottery, and a few metal objects such as gold and silver pins.

blocks.name: sc-timeline
blocks.cap: Linear A spans about 1800 to 1450 BC, overlapping Cretan hieroglyphs at the start and handing over to Linear B at the end.

blocks.html: Why does the size of the corpus matter so much? Compare: about 7,400 signs of Linear A, against tens of thousands of words of Linear B. Every pattern a decipherer finds must be seen many times to be trusted. With little text, and much of it lists of names and numbers, there are few patterns to test.

Thinking Linear A is a large body of texts. It is small: about 7,400 signs in all, mostly short lists, many damaged. Check: the whole corpus would fit in a few pages of a book, while the Linear B archives fill large volumes.

blocks.title: Where most of it is
blocks.q: Which single site has produced the most Linear A?
steps: Hagia Triada, near Phaistos, has about half of all Linear A inscriptions.

blocks.title: How much?
blocks.q: About 1,400 inscriptions have about 7,400 signs in all. About how many signs is that per inscription, on average?
blocks.a: About 5 signs per inscription: most are very short.
